extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: electric kick scooter, approx. 1.25 x 0.5 x 1.1 m (L x W x H), 10 in air tires
extras.notes: front faces -Y; stands upright on both wheels and its side stand; wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); e-scooter_steering (stem, folding hinge, T-bar, grips, display, headlight, fork, front fender) has its origin on the steering axis, tilted 16 deg: rotate around (0, 0.276, 0.961) in Blender Z-up = (0, 0.961, -0.276) in glTF Y-up; e-scooter_kickstand folds up around local X (about +60 deg) at its pivot; display shows abstract bars only, no digits, no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
